Definition: from G2034 and G5507; seven times a thousand:--seven thousand.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, heptakischílioi means seven thousand. It occurs just once, in Romans.
TheologicalSignificance: I take heptakischílioi as it stands — seven thousand — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
